episodeTitle.en: Unorthodox PM tips: Automating user insights, unselling candidates, decision logs, more | Kevin Yien

guestBioOfficial.en: Kevin Yien leads product for merchant experiences at Stripe. Before that, he meandered his way from being a technical designer to a product manager, built the restaurants business and ecosystem team at Square, and most recently was head of product and design at Mutiny. He also makes ice cream and teaches for fun. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why aspiring PMs should start in engineering, design, or sales

title.en: Unorthodox PM tips: Automating user insights, unselling candidates, decision logs, more | Kevin Yien

summary.en: Kevin argues every PM should be able to sell and support their own product, because if you can't, you can't be trusted to build it. He advocates keeping a decision log to build product sense through repeated reps and outcome review. The episode also covers his unconventional "unsell email" hiring tactic and practical uses of AI in PM work.
summary.zh: 凯文认为，每个 PM 都应该能卖、也能支持自己的产品，因为如果做不到，就不该被信任去构建它。他主张用"决策日志"通过反复决策与复盘结果来培养产品感。本期还涵盖了他非传统的"劝退邮件"招聘法，以及 AI 在 PM 工作中的实际应用。
